[[File:Jonny the Beard (zombie) chathead.png|left]]
'''Jonny the beard''' is a man who hangs out in the [[Blue Moon Inn]] in Southern [[Varrock]]. He is a [[Black Arm Gang]] member who must be killed (and his [[Intel report]] picked up and given to [[Straven]], the [[Phoenix Gang]] leader) if a player wishes to join the Phoenix Gang during the [[Shield of Arrav]] quest.

In [[Dimension of Disaster: Shield of Arrav]], his [[New Varrock]] counterpart has joined the [[Phoenix Gang]] and stolen [[Katrine]]'s [[Black arm]]. He must be fought in order to get it back.
